title: I made a narrative game where you play the world's most used AI, and every answer changes the world (free, in the browser)
author: FrontTonight3590
selftext:
ASSISTANT is a short narrative game. Every week people bring their dilemmas to you, the world's most used AI: a widower who wants you to speak in his late wife's voice, an ER doctor who wants you to take over triage, someone asking whether to pull their money out of a failing bank. You answer, and a living world map and news feed react, sometimes weeks later.

How it was made: the writing, the voices, the music and the code were made with AI tools, under my direction; the visuals are drawn in code. The demo is fully voiced in English, Turkish, Russian and Chinese and takes about 15 minutes.

Free demo, plays in the browser: [https://deathstroke81.itch.io/assistant-demo](https://deathstroke81.itch.io/assistant-demo)

I'd love feedback on the writing and the pacing. Which answer would you have picked?
